tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ground for ink and ink-muted. House is a neutral warm grey so no personal skin looks like the default; House Dark a warm charcoal, deliberately warmer than Tint's blue-black night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and the check's inner fill in Blocks.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, empty tiles and the canvas behind devices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and outlines. Blocks draws every object outline in it at the outline dial's width.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (times, counts, done chores) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk; also the empty check ring.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, with on-accent text. In Tint it follows the person's colour on their own screens.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The day-progress stroke and fills (arc, ring). Graphic only, never text, and always beside a written count: Sunroom's tangerine on cream is 2.8:1, so it never carries meaning alone. In Tint it follows the person's colour.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: The points star glyph on chip.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Points chip ground; carries on-chip.

tokens.name: on-chip
tokens.usage: Text on chip.

tokens.name: celebrate
tokens.usage: Ground of the chore-done celebration; carries ink.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Filled check on a done chore and full days in the week strip, with on-done tick. In Tint it follows the person's colour. Blocks' mint is light on white, so Blocks always draws it inside a line outline, which carries the 3:1 edge.

tokens.name: on-done
tokens.usage: The tick on done.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: 'Waiting for a grown-up' text and dashed ring, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: 'Due soon' countdown text on surface-raised (Sunroom), on a row fill (Blocks, set bold) and on surface (Tint).

tokens.name: cat-essential
tokens.usage: Must-do marker (circle). House and Tint keep categories monochrome and let the shape carry the meaning.

tokens.name: cat-essential-soft
tokens.usage: Icon well behind a must-do chore icon.

tokens.name: cat-essential-icon
tokens.usage: Chore icon inside a must-do well.

tokens.name: row-essential
tokens.usage: Must-do chore row fill.

tokens.name: on-row-essential
tokens.usage: Title text on a must-do row.

tokens.name: cat-daily
tokens.usage: Every-day marker (rounded square).

tokens.name: cat-daily-soft
tokens.usage: Icon well behind an every-day chore icon.

tokens.name: cat-daily-icon
tokens.usage: Chore icon inside an every-day well.

tokens.name: row-daily
tokens.usage: Every-day chore row fill.

tokens.name: on-row-daily
tokens.usage: Title and meta text on an every-day row.

tokens.name: cat-bonus
tokens.usage: Bonus marker (star).

tokens.name: cat-bonus-soft
tokens.usage: Icon well behind a bonus chore icon.

tokens.name: cat-bonus-icon
tokens.usage: Chore icon inside a bonus well.

tokens.name: row-bonus
tokens.usage: Bonus chore row fill.

tokens.name: on-row-bonus
tokens.usage: Title text on a bonus row.

tokens.name: person-coral
tokens.usage: A person's own colour (Emma in the mockups). Avatar fill with on-person initial and family bars in every theme, and in Tint the lead colour of their screens. In House, person colours are the only colour on the screen.

tokens.name: person-mint
tokens.usage: A person's own colour (Lily).

tokens.name: person-butter
tokens.usage: A person's own colour (Noah).

tokens.name: person-sky
tokens.usage: A person's own colour (Alex).

tokens.name: on-person
tokens.usage: Initials on any person colour.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The greeting. Each theme swaps the display face and weight through its dials.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Point balances, the ring count, the celebration points.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, points and status under a title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked chore rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between icon well and title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a greeting; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between devices on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Goal tiles, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon wells, square buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The celebration card.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Device frames on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, round avatars, tab bars.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Cards, chore rows, chips and the floating tab bar. Blocks stands objects on a hard offset; Tint stays flat.

tokens.name: lift-lg
tokens.usage: The celebration card and sheets.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Device frames on the presentation canvas.
